backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the social app's backend with data types and logic for posts, comments, notifications, messages, conversations, user profiles, follows, and a friend request system including send/respond/cancel/unfriend operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles to their relevant source files, component dependencies, and test IDs for features including auto-scroll, comments, share, and profile overlay on ShortSportPage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable recent changes of components, pages, hooks, and stylesheets.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, card, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to "Smileup" and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a user's profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to a gradient circle with initials, supporting xs through xl sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), active-state highlighting, a dot badge on Messages when conversations exist, and auto-hide on the /shortsport route.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, allowing users to upload audio files or toggle a recording state. Displays each track with volume control, mute toggle, and remove options.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design settings, including aspect ratio selection, solid color/gradient background presets, shape overlays, and sticker layers.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based React component that renders the current video frame, including background color, text layers, stickers, filters (via CSS), vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays video/image/blank clips on a scrubable ruler with a playhead, supports clip removal, and allows adding blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling motion graphic effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the editor state, with an active effects summary display.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component offering filter presets (moody, cinematic, noir, etc.) and individual sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, and other filter settings.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, placement, size/rotation controls, and per-sticker deletion.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and editing text overlay layers in a video editor, with controls for font, color, size, alignment, animation, bold/italic, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transition effects and allows applying them between consecutive clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, BottomNav, and a router Outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, relative timestamps, and click-to-navigate behavior, marking them as read on interaction.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A social media post card component with like, comment, share, and bookmark actions, intersection-observer-based view tracking, and author profile navigation.
A dialog modal that displays the current user's posts as a thumbnail grid, allowing selection of a post to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog modal for sharing a post with selected friends via direct message, showing a friends list with multi-select and a send action.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable row of story avatars using mock data, with an 'Add Story' button for the current user and a story viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, timestamp, and a progress bar. Closes on Escape key press or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread count, search button, and sign-out option. Hides on the '/shortsport' route and manages a notifications panel dropdown.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying trending creator profile cards with rank, avatar, follower/post counts, and a follow button. Uses mock user data and navigates to the explore page on card click.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation. Supports follow toggling and like interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for ICP, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for profiles, posts, comments, notifications, messages, and friend requests, providing typed query and mutation helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes including color tokens, glassmorphism utilities, and gradient text helpers.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Story, Message, Conversation) and exports static mock arrays of users, stories, and related data for development/testing purposes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, and formatters for large numbers, time durations, and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for photo/video/GIF/poster media types, with caption input and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with timeline, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export sub-panels.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore/search page with debounced search input and tabs for browsing posts or searching users, fetching data via `useGetAllPosts` and `useSearchUsers` hooks and rendering filtered results.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a sorted list of posts. Handles loading skeletons, error states, empty states, and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup with a gradient wordmark, tagline, Internet Identity login button, and feature highlights grid.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI showing a conversation list and a message thread panel with support for text and shared post messages, unread counts, and mark-as-read functionality.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user profile page supporting profile creation/editing, avatar upload, follower/following counts, and a grid of the user's posts with a comments sheet.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical reel viewer that auto-plays videos, supports mute/unmute, optimistic likes, comments sheet, share modal, and auto-scroll on video end.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page that displays a user's profile (avatar, stats, post grid) identified by principal or handle, with follow/unfollow and friend request actions using existing query hooks.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines and exports the TanStack Router route tree, mapping URL paths (feed, explore, profile, messages, ShortSport, etc.) to their corresponding page components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (gold, coral, surface, chart, sidebar), fonts, border radii, shadows, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the ShortSport feature enhancement work (auto-scroll, comments/share, profile navigation overlay), including existing features, new requests, architectural notes, and versioning metadata.
